basis: Author-declared disposable local Kiva fixture, policy information confirmed in the bound implementation; expected obligations remain source-derived. This is not an external operator statement.
canonical_submitted_fixture: Canonical Statement maps come from each retained Statement, including root/SubStatement and every Context Activity role; Agent/Group data remain exact. The Activities resource merges first-known properties in stored-time/id order, fills missing language/property entries, and keeps extension-owner values atomic. Native inventory fixtures separately verify authorized and rejected corrections. Accept-Language fields are combined in received order; each tag uses its most-specific matching range including q=0, then quality and header order select an available tag. The adopted deterministic fallback remains when none is acceptable.
authorization_policy: The ordinary portable target uses optional authorization with refused/read-only tokens configured by conformance_lib.sh. Separate native fixtures use an actual external BearerTokenVerifier decision log, require authentication, exercise operation scopes, and configure disjoint subject-based Statement ID sets through KIVA_XAPI_STATEMENT_VISIBILITY_JSON. Every continuation reapplies its verified caller permission; no external production IdP service is claimed.
authority_policy: Kiva always overwrites accepted submitted authority with an Agent Account: homePage https://example.org/kiva/conformance/auth and name equal to verified principal subject, or kiva-lrs for permitted anonymous access. Trusted input-authority retention is not enabled. Native external-verifier fixtures independently test two subjects and two credentials for the same subject; injectivity is not required.
interaction_policy: Kiva validates interactionType presence/vocabulary, common JSON validity, component/list/String types and Language Maps. Pattern grammar, grading and characterstring parameters are not interpreted. Whitespace-free component ids are producer advice; fill-in250 characters is explanatory, not a receiver cutoff. Native fixtures cover every type and parameter scope independently from the controlled consumer interpreter.
resolvable_metadata_policy: Kiva has no external metadata consumer, metadata-host route or deferred fetch worker. Native reachable JSON/HTML host controls qualify conditional applicability separately from mandatory Activity fallback and submitted-information preservation.
cursor_policy: Kiva continuation links requery current stored data with a stored/id anchor and have no expiry. Native fixtures verify insertion/voiding between pages, tied timestamps, terminal empty more and replay after a controlled 40-day advance.

about_context.cause_basis: About handler rejects every query parameter; auth fixture independently refuses invalid-credential. No precedence of multiple unrelated invalid causes is inferred.

parameter_vocabulary.evidence: Source-bound explicit query allowlists in crates/kiva-server/src/surfaces/xapi/request/query.rs and the bound About/Agents/Activities/Document handlers. Vocabulary established before executing the rejection probe, separately from its response.

signature_policy: Local trusted certificate policy from KIVA_XAPI_CERTIFICATE_POLICY; independently configured anchor and certificate/issuer/time-bound authenticated out-of-band status. CRL/OCSP/discovery not selected. Original-byte RSA SHA256/384/512 and exact >=2048-bit JWS modulus; D10=A unknown not-evaluated/known failure rejected, D11 decoded duplicate rejection. Named native controls exercise selected certificate-name/DER/path/status boundaries and combinations. Their passing outcomes do not prove all requirement semantics; confirmed counterexamples remain product gaps. Public synthetic keys are test-only.
related_activity_policy: Related Activity filtering reads direct Activity ids from the four declared Context Activity roles, accepting singleton and array forms at root and SubStatement scopes. Opaque definition/extension contents do not introduce related Activities. Object StatementRef expansion and paging retain these same boundaries.
attachment_output_policy: Collection raw parts are deduplicated by hexadecimal digest value. A nonempty optional Content-Type is emitted only when equivalence with all metadata references in that returned page is established, including SubStatement and fileUrl-only references. Otherwise it is omitted; stored metadata and raw bytes remain unchanged and required hash/binary-encoding headers remain present.
